note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a Const 48(1)(a), GUY 9,  Schedule 1, 2; A06b Const 48(1)(a), GUY 9,  Schedule 1, 2; L05 Const 46(1)): ordinary naturalisation after 6 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Citizenship at birth is read from the same dataset's 2024 coding of modes A01a (descent, born in country: No provision), A01b (descent, born abroad: Generational transmission restriction: conditional on birthplace/place of residence /mode under which parent acquired citizenship), A02a (birth in country: Generally applicable provision) and A02b (birth in country to a parent born there: No provision), as its codebook (RSC/GLOBALCIT 2025/01, sections 3.2.1a to 3.2.2b) defines them: by birth in the territory unconditionally; by descent from either parent, a child born abroad on the limit the dataset states (the dataset codes no separate descent rule for a child born in the country, birth there giving it; the parent's sex is read from mode A01b). Changes to the law at birth after 1 January 2024 weren't checked for this file.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Guyana, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in Guyana for 12 months immediately prior to the application, and 5 out of 7 years prior to the 12-month period. Intent to reside in the country. ... n.a. ... A person acquires citizenship of another country by a voluntary and official act otherwise than by marriage after May 25, 1966. ... No provision ... Generational transmission restriction: conditional on birthplace/place of residence /mode under which parent acquired citizenship ... Person is born abroad to a citizen otherwise than by descent.; Person is born abroad to a citizen who was also born abroad. ... Generally applicable provision ... Person is born in Guyana. Unless born to a foreign diplomat and neither parent is a citizen, or one of the parents is an enemy alien and the child is born in a place then under occupation by the enemy. ... No provision

atBirth.descentAbroad: Person is born abroad to a citizen otherwise than by descent.; Person is born abroad to a citizen who was also born abroad.
